messages:
Sam K: Quick async snapshot — docs/devex check-in (SDKs + quickstarts + sample apps). What I did / blockers / today.

Priya Nair: What I did: landed node quickstart README updates and small fix to the env var table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/342.

Priya Nair: Blocker: packaging script on mac keeps failing for the wheel step, seeing `ERROR: invalid wheel format` in the CI.

devex-bot: CI: samplekit/macos-wheel — pipeline failed on job `build-wheel` (a11). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/2211.

Luis R: I can take a look at the mac wheel failure later today. Probable culprit: `manylinux` tags or python tag mismatch. Quick check: which python versions are we building for?

Priya Nair: We're building for 3.9/3.10. Local `pip wheel` works on linux container but not on mac-latest runner.

Maya Chen: What I did: updated the SDK snippets for streaming responses and added a short troubleshooting section for `stream` vs `response` behaviors in the Node SDK. PR coming shortly.

Connor O: Today: will raise a tiny PR that unifies the sampleapp config for local vs CI — fewer env var surprises. Also aim to review Priya's packaging PR.

Sam K: Blockers for me: need a quick review on the docs section that explains the recommended batching settings for low-latency chat (small example + config). Pinged @Maya and @Luis on the draft.

Luis R: Ack, will skim the batching doc this afternoon. Main nit: add an example with `max_total_tokens` + TTL cache note.

Maya Chen: Saw the draft — left inline comments about graphs needing alt text. Also noticed one sample snippet still uses `client.generate()` old API, changed in SDK v1.3.0.

Priya Nair: Connor — thanks. If you can also add a short step in the quickstart to run `pip install -r dev-requirements.txt` before `./scripts/build-wheel.sh` that might reduce confusions.

Connor O: Will do. Also tagging @Luis to double-check the CI runner matrix to avoid duplicated builds.

Sam K: Small coordination ask: if you touch quickstarts, add a single-line changelog entry in `docs/quickstarts/CHANGELOG.md` so release notes capture tiny doc fixes.

Priya Nair: Noted. Will add changelog entry to my PR.

devex-bot: Reminder: docs site deploy scheduled at 18:00 UTC. Any doc PRs that should land before the deploy, please comment `land-prior` on the PR.

Maya Chen: FYI — I'll target the batching doc and Node SDK snippet fixes for the pre-deploy window.

Sam K: Thanks everyone. If anyone is blocked on reviews, drop a quick `+review` here and I'll nudge. :thumbsup:
